content.title: How to watch High Point vs. Arkansas men’s basketball: Second Round TV channel and streaming options for March 21
content.text: The No. 4 seed Arkansas Razorbacks (27-8) and the No. 12 seed High Point Panthers (31-4) will meet in the NCAA Tournament with a spot in the Sweet 16 on the line on Saturday at Moda Center, beginning at 9:45 p.m. ET.How to watch High Point Panthers vs. Arkansas Razorbacks Venue: Moda Center Time: 9:45 p.m. ET TV: TBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. High Point vs. Arkansas odds Spread: Arkansas -12.5 (-108), High Point +12.5 (-112) Favorite Moneyline: Arkansas -909 Underdog Moneyline: High Point +584 Total: 170.5 Total Over Odds: -115 Total Under Odds: -108 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Arkansas’ +354 scoring differential (outscoring opponents by 10.1 points per game) is a result of scoring 90.1 points per game (second in college basketball) while allowing 80.0 per outing (330th in college basketball). Arkansas makes 8.2 three-pointers per game (135th in college basketball) at a 38.3% rate (17th in college basketball), compared to the 7.8 its opponents make while shooting 31.8% from beyond the arc. High Point has a +671 scoring differential, topping opponents by 19.2 points per game. It is putting up 89.8 points per game, third in college basketball, and is giving up 70.6 per contest to rank 87th in college basketball. High Point knocks down 9.4 three-pointers per game (60th in college basketball), 1.9 more than its opponents. It shoots 35.6% from deep (86th in college basketball), and its opponents are shooting 31.9%.
